investigation_record.reasoning_summary: The transaction triggered a moderate ML risk score of 0.54, which is below the threshold typically associated with high-confidence fraud in historical precedents (where scores >0.82 were cleared as benign). The graph neighborhood shows no multi-hop linked cards and only a single shared device count, failing to meet the criteria for Typology B (Distributed Device Ring) which requires a device linked to >=3 distinct accounts. Additionally, there is no evidence of Geo-Velocity anomalies (Typology E) as the transaction is online and no impossible travel data is present. Given the low severity signal and lack of corroborating graph-based fraud indicators, the risk profile aligns with benign activity.
